input: Research electric vehicle tax credits and rebates

gold.taskTitle: Research EV Tax Credits and Rebates Available to You
gold.taskDescription: Research the electric vehicle tax credits and rebates that apply to the user's specific situation, vehicle, and location.

questions.title: Are you buying new, used, or leasing an EV?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is purchasing a new vehicle, a used vehicle, or leasing, as eligibility and credit amounts differ significantly across these options.

questions.title: Do you have a specific EV make and model in mind?
questions.description: Identify the target vehicle, since federal tax credits under the Inflation Reduction Act are tied to specific makes, models, and assembly locations.

questions.title: What country and state or province do you live in?
questions.description: Establish the user's location to identify which federal, state, provincial, or local incentive programs apply to them.

questions.title: What is your approximate annual household income?
questions.description: Determine income level, since federal EV tax credits have income caps that can disqualify higher earners from receiving the full credit.

questions.title: Are you buying as an individual or through a business?
questions.description: Clarify whether the purchase is personal or commercial, as the commercial clean vehicle credit has different rules and amounts than the consumer credit.

questions.title: Do you owe federal income tax most years?
questions.description: Establish whether the user has sufficient federal tax liability to actually use a non-refundable tax credit, which affects how valuable the credit is to them.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for making this purchase?
questions.description: Understand when the user plans to buy, since credit rules, income thresholds, and qualifying vehicle lists change year to year and deadlines matter.
